# Provenance

`input.edf` is a ten-minute excerpt of MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database record 100, lead MLII. The source is published by PhysioNet under the Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0. The excerpt was resampled from 360 Hz to 200 Hz and converted from mV to uV for this family. See the NeuroKit2 container in this family for the extraction and validation record.
